source: Complete borrowed raw byte slice; no framing or aggregate byte cap is added.
capacity_precedence: Output capacity is checked before any input read. Short output changes no buffer.
complete: valid_up_to equals source length; error_len equals zero.
invalid: The first invalid sequence has Rust str::from_utf8 valid_up_to and error_len semantics.
incomplete: The input ends in 1..3 otherwise valid bytes of a partial scalar. valid_up_to names its first byte.
effects: Only output[0..32] is written on success. Source, workspace and output tail remain unchanged. No pointer is retained.
public_owner: Utf8StreamParser keeps its original Vec and inner call/rollback/finish order. HIA decides UTF-8 validity and the exact error offsets.
native_scope: Linux x86-64 GNU, opt-in hia-native. Public library owner; no installed-CLI reachability claim.
